assets.name: 童子 · 福音
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent full-body unit sprite for an isometric Chinese science-fantasy auto-chess game. Primary request: create the Gospel Acolyte (童子), a small non-humanoid alien energy-support creature, based on this clearly defined silhouette: one large smooth pear/seed-shaped chalk-white organic shell crown, small electric-blue luminous eyes and cyan glowing seams, compact midnight-blue segmented underside, four slim bent chitinous spider-like legs and two small curled grasping appendages. A pale blue luminous core inside its shell suggests a continuous supportive energy field. Quiet, gentle, mysterious, slightly hovering posture. This is a compact alien creature, not a human child, not a robed Taoist, and not a large crab or insect swarm. Style/medium: polished hand-painted 3D strategy-game miniature, readable sculpted volumes and premium game asset materials matching existing fantasy miniature sprites. Composition/framing: single whole creature, three-quarter front view facing viewer-right, slightly elevated isometric camera, centered, body and all limbs fully visible with 12 percent clear padding, strong readable silhouette at small game-board size. Lighting: soft key light, restrained cyan rim light localized to the creature. Palette: ivory white, deep cobalt blue, electric cyan; subtle organic surface texture. Constraints: actual transparent background with clean alpha, no scenery, floor, pedestal, cast shadow, caption, letters, UI, frame, watermark, extra characters or separate props. Keep glow compact so the cutout remains crisp.
